search_log.notes: Replaced prior greenhouse yield-factor records that used unverifiable titles/DOIs. New records use reported effect sizes only; CIs stored only when the source published them. Open-field biostimulant means are labelled as such and not treated as soilless greenhouse results.

search_log.scope: protocol crop x factor grid (light, CO2, temperature, VPD, irrigation, nutrients, grafting, density, pollination, disease, structure, photoperiod) for six greenhouse crops
search_log.method: Europe PMC grid plus targeted retrieval of WUR diffuse-glass, vegetable deficit-irrigation meta-analysis, Alberta pepper production guide, lettuce tipburn airflow, cucumber grafting/PM, pepper heat
search_log.notes: Added 18 page-facing yield-factor records. Null/negative evidence included (deficit irrigation, heat, BER, tipburn). Combined light x CO2 and grafting x fertigation kept as interactions, not stacked percentages.

tomato.Disease: BER included; pathogen meta still thin

cucumber.Disease: powdery mildew recovery included; Canadian high-wire pooling still a gap

tree-seedlings.Photoperiod/blackout: directional primary study included; pooled % still a gap

research_gaps: Alberta-specific replicated lighting and CO2 trials for cucumber and pepper (most lighting economics are Ontario/Finland/Netherlands).
Greenhouse-only biostimulant yield meta-analysis (vegetable +22.8% mean remains open-field; lettuce tipburn biostimulant is quality not biomass).
Quantified powdery mildew and Pythium yield-loss pooling for Canadian high-wire cucumber (current PM record is recovery vs an untreated epidemic).
Pooled short-day blackout survival or RGP effect size for white spruce and lodgepole pine.
Pepper grafting, CO2, and BER/VPD cells still lack a page record with a reported percent.
Automation/sensing yield trials (protocol section S) — only count when a production outcome is reported.
